description: E97 — 国王印度古典变例马德普拉塔，双兵链对攻教科书

intro.popup_en:
Pawn-Chain Direction, Practice 7
A classic battle between two pawn chains: White's e4-d5 chain points toward Black's queenside, while Black's e5-d6 chain points toward White's king. Advance along the direction of your own chain.
intro.popup:
兵链方向练习7
最经典双兵链对攻！
白链e4-d5→指向黑后翼
黑链e5-d6→指向白王翼
两个兵链方向完全相对！
每步棋都要沿本方链方向前进！

outro.popup_en: Summary: d5 locks the chains, ...f5-f4 fixes the kingside, c5 breaks on the queenside, and ...g4 launches the final attack. A clear demonstration of a pawn-chain race.
outro.popup:
总结：d5锁定双链 → f5-f4锁死 → c5突破后翼 → g4总攻
双兵链对攻最纯粹示范！

moves.popup_en: e4! White establishes a broad central presence with pawns on e4 and d4.
...d6 sets up Black's strategy of attacking the center indirectly.
...e5!! Black advances and begins forming the e5-d6 pawn chain.
d5!! The two pawn chains are now fixed: White's e4-d5 chain points toward the queenside, while Black's e5-d6 chain points toward White's kingside. This is the classic pawn-chain attacking structure.
moves.popup:
d5！！双兵链形成！
白e4-d5链→指向黑后翼
黑e5-d6链→指向白王翼
这是双兵链对攻最经典结构！

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 reroutes the knight in preparation for ...f5.
...f5!! Black advances along the direction of its pawn chain. The planned ...f4 will lock the position and prepare the kingside race.
moves.popup:
f5！！黑f5！沿黑方兵链方向推进
f4锁死局面，王翼竞速准备就绪

moves.popup_en: f3 prepares White's c5 break, targeting the base of Black's chain on d6.
f4!! White fixes the center. With the chains locked, the race on both wings begins.
moves.popup: f4！！f4锁定！兵链冻结，双翼竞速正式开始

moves.popup_en: c5!! White breaks on the queenside, advancing in the direction of its pawn chain and attacking the base on d6.
moves.popup:
c5！！白方c5！沿兵链方向后翼突破
攻击d6根部！

moves.popup_en: ...g5 expands on the kingside, following the direction of Black's pawn chain.
moves.popup: g5！黑方g侧推进，沿黑方链方向

moves.popup_en: cxd6 exchanges pawns at the base of the chain.
...g4!! Black launches the full kingside attack.
...hxg4! Black's pawn mass surges forward. The opposite-wing race is entering its decisive phase: which side will reach the opposing king first?
moves.popup:
hxg4！黑方兵海总冲锋！
双翼竞速进入最后阶段——谁先到达对方的王？
